intro.title: A licensed firm for electricity board line work.
intro.p1: We hold an A-Class electrical contractor licence (Lic. No. A-1578) and are registered under GST. Our work is on LT distribution lines: erecting steel tubular poles, extending lines, stringing ACSR conductor, fixing stay sets and earthing.
intro.p2: We work for State Electricity Board sub-divisions, for example Electrical Sub Division Bhaderwar. We also supply line material such as RCC muff pipes, shackle insulators, D-iron, nuts and bolts, and aluminium paint. We take up work at any location in Himachal Pradesh.
